conclusions: Local native workspace construction omits creator identity explicitly. No account/profile API or new persisted identity is needed for this local-only popup.
Blo uses name, otherwise email, only when a creator profile resolves; neither placeholder nor separator is rendered without a label.

Reuse existing agoTime for finite valid local timestamps with SS falsy/invalid-range guards. Future-clamping, timezone offsets, rounding thresholds and full-month branches are source-aligned; executable equivalence remains unrun.
Single repo prop caller handoff stays inside DE6-cleared header range. Existing context actions and rename dialog are reused.

unchanged_frozen_inputs.Title4: Separate follow-on; no product writes/fixture substitution in this change.

verification_limits: Static source/data qualification only at this checkpoint. No local Node, tests, typecheck, install, build, server, browser or native execution.
Mounted regression mocks popover transport and fixes the age helper clock; it does not prove native pixels, actual Base UI focus, touch or nested-menu dismissal.
Real app binary identity is rechecked, but retained JS extraction was not rerun; statements about source are not live behavior observations.
Excluded from unchanged #992 release cut. Package/native consumption belongs to existing release owner.
